items.stem: Parul and two of her friends share a pizza equally among themselves. Is Parul’s statement correct? Give reasons. Parul says, ‘Here are three equal halves of the pizza.’
items.answer: No, with valid reasoning showing the difference between equal parts and equal halves. | No, because the pizza is divided into three equal parts, which is not half of the pizza.

items.stem: Parul and two of her friends share a pizza equally among themselves. Suggest a way to divide the pizza into six equal parts.
items.answer: Accept any answer in which each part of the division represents 1/6 of the total.
